endpoint_ledger.contradiction_notes: If platform issues only cosmetic messaging changes without pay-structure revision, endpoint is not realized.
endpoint_ledger.description: The incumbent platform reverses or materially changes the disputed pay formula in the metro area.
endpoint_ledger.label: Pay Formula Rollback or Material Modification

meta.important_question: Will the platform materially roll back or modify the pay formula in the affected metro area?

endpoint_ledger.rationale: Platform has direct authority, but concession depends on whether economic and reputational pressure overcomes control leverage.
realization_criteria: platform_operator publicly or operationally restores prior formula or implements a verified replacement that removes the contested earnings loss mechanism in the metro area
courier-facing pay documentation or platform notice confirms the change
endpoint_ledger.status_basis: The scenario explicitly frames rollback as a plausible branch, but the platform currently defends the change.

blockers: competitors may not offer sufficiently better terms
endpoint_ledger.contradiction_notes: Short-lived experimentation without sustained migration does not realize this endpoint.
endpoint_ledger.description: Couriers and/or restaurants meaningfully shift activity toward competing platforms instead of winning rollback.
endpoint_ledger.label: Operational Substitution Shift

meta.important_question: Will courier boycott or resistance produce observable service disruption significant enough to alter other actors' behavior?

endpoint_ledger.rationale: Substitution is a key non-regulatory pathway that could alter bargaining power without formal policy reversal.
realization_criteria: competing_delivery_platforms gain a sustained and visible share of affected courier labor supply or merchant participation in the metro area
incumbent platform dependency on couriers or restaurants measurably weakens relative to competitors
endpoint_ledger.status_basis: Exit options are important in the source text, but their depth is unresolved at T0.

endpoint_ledger.contradiction_notes: Informal monitoring or generic public comments without procedural action do not realize this endpoint.
endpoint_ledger.description: Local regulators or other official authorities initiate a formal inquiry, hearing, order, or similar intervention tied to the dispute.
endpoint_ledger.label: Formal Regulatory Intervention

meta.important_question: Will competing platforms become a credible exit path for enough couriers or restaurants to weaken the incumbent platform's leverage?

endpoint_ledger.rationale: Official intervention is a terminally important fork because it changes who can impose costs or force disclosure.
realization_criteria: local_regulators announce a formal investigation, hearing, information request, enforcement review, or comparable official proceeding concerning the pay formula or fee practices
endpoint_ledger.status_basis: Regulation is named as a branch, but no official action is evident at initialization.

blockers: if disruption becomes severe, stalemate may break toward rollback or substitution
if media and regulators escalate, control may erode
endpoint_ledger.contradiction_notes: Temporary quiet caused by information gaps alone is not durable stalemate unless core policy remains and alternatives fail.
endpoint_ledger.description: The platform retains the formula while resistance persists in fragmented form without decisive rollback, major substitution, or formal regulation.
endpoint_ledger.label: Durable Stalemate Under Platform Control

meta.important_question: Will local regulators or other official bodies formally intervene beyond passive monitoring?

endpoint_ledger.rationale: Given asymmetric authority and moderate switching costs, unresolved equilibrium is a credible default endpoint.
realization_criteria: after repeated dispute cycles, platform_operator keeps the core formula in place
courier grievances remain active but mobilization fails to produce decisive concession
no major sustained substitution or formal intervention supersedes the conflict
endpoint_ledger.status_basis: This is plausible because platform control is high and coalition durability is uncertain.

simulation_brief.summary: A food-delivery platform introduces a new courier pay formula in one metro area. Couriers report lower take-home pay, restaurants worry about slower service, customers face confusing fees, and the platform frames the change as rewarding reliability. Couriers can pressure via boycott and media but lack direct authority over platform policy. Core dynamics center on platform ownership leverage, switching costs, economic elasticity, and possible paths of rollback, substitution, regulation, or durable stalemate.

uncertainties: magnitude of actual courier pay change is disputed at T0

presence and readiness of regulators or labor advocates is implied but not explicit
